sql_desc: Microbiology/Biochemistry result slip: ONE ROW PER RESULT ITEM, each row repeating the header (patient identity from zdata_person via zdata_visit, LNo / received / reported / signers from the lab report header). That is the shape SdReport needs - html widgets bind row 0, the table widget loops every row. Takes the lab report's own `xparentx` as the parameter, because one order carries several items; zdata_lab_result_item.xparentx is the FK back to it. Items are $unwind-ed with preserveNullAndEmptyArrays so a report with no item rows still prints its header. Every field is guarded with $ifNull and a length check: `age` is mixed-type (8 and "4") and attachment records have no timestamps. specimen and collected have no source in either lab collection and return "-". The Result column prints `result_unit` (value and unit joined here, so an absent unit leaves no trailing space); `interpretation` is the raw interpretation_code, which is an empty string on every live item today. The two signers are resolved against core_user on _id / username / person_code / provider_code, giving the name and the footer's '<position> ทน.<certificate_code>' licence line; no live source id matches a user yet, so today it falls back to the LIS source name with a blank licence line. NO top-level $limit - the runner treats one as the limit on the whole response (gotcha 34).
sql_note: EMR_SENSITIVE_RESULT_REPORT_ROW_GATE_V3: Result Items use Result Report ID only; Sensitive grants use each row's parent CPOE Order.
